controller_defect: The superseded controller enforced the 600000-obligation ceiling per invocation instead of across the whole campaign.
governing_effect: Because the declared rule made any cap breach terminal and forbade a result claim, later ledgers and successful runs cannot exclude, reset, or repair the 835446-obligation total.
retention_reason: The record is preserved to disclose the control failure and prevent later post-breach outputs from being misread as compliant evidence.
